description: Source code for handling triggers and interrupts for the STMicroelectronics LPS22HH pressure and temperature sensor in Zephyr OS, including interrupt setup, callback handling, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: lps22hh_enable_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the interrupt pin for the LPS22HH sensor.

methods.name: lps22hh_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready interrupt, calls registered handler if available.

methods.name: lps22hh_intr_callback
methods.description: Callback to handle interrupt event, signals thread or work queue.

methods.name: lps22hh_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback function to handle GPIO interrupt and invoke handler.

methods.name: lps22hh_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts in own thread context.

methods.name: lps22hh_work_cb
methods.description: Workqueue callback for handling interrupts in global thread context.

methods.name: lps22hh_ibi_cb
methods.description: I3C IBI callback for interrupt handling.

methods.name: lps22hh_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes interrupt handling, configures GPIO or I3C, sets up callback mechanisms.
